published.source: priest client 70425 port (DP 24s, talents and knobs re-searched with raid hits), 2026-10-16

summary: Deep Shadow with Discipline points for Twin Disciplines, Mental Strength and Inner Focus, and 3 Holy points for Twilight Focus's pushback protection.
rotation: Pre-pull: Shadowform at -3s, Mind Blast at -1.5s that lands at the pull; the on-use trinket and Major Spellblasting Potion at -0.1s
Dark Sacrifice (Undead) below 10% mana; racials and trinkets on cooldown
Shadow Word: Pain whenever it is down (9+ s left in the fight)
Devouring Plague whenever it is down and off its 24s cooldown (12+ s left)
Shadow Word: Death on cooldown, then Inner Focus right before Mind Blast and Mind Blast on cooldown
Mind Flay to fill; clipped after the second tick if SW:P or Devouring Plague fell off, never clipped for Mind Blast
caveats: Only the 2-piece set bonus is active. Raiments 4-piece and 5-piece not measured since Devouring Plague's 24s cooldown.
Periodic spells crit per tick (Forever rule). Assumed: Shadow Weaving applies to the priest's own Shadow damage.
Mind Flay rolls hit once and isn't hasted. SW:Death backlash is ignored.
Left out: Brilliant Wizard Oil (+12.5) and Elixir of Sages (+13.9).
Improved Mind Flay compounds: each tick does 20% more than the last. Dark Inspiration's Spirit applies to the priest only.
Mana barely matters (about 13 min to empty).
notes: Request from mksettings unchanged (spec shadow, 180s, durationVariation 20); it matches the shipped encounter and DefaultConsumes.
